changelog:
v4.2.7 — Fixes the app freezing / "app isn't responding"

• Fixes the app freezing or showing "app isn't responding" while browsing Movies, Series, and the Home screen — the remote would stop responding and the app had to be force-closed. Poster grids are now much lighter on memory, so scrolling stays smooth and no longer stalls.
• Lower memory use across all poster rows; faster, smoother scrolling.

Includes all v4.2.4/v4.2.5/v4.2.6 playback fixes (4K, Dolby Vision, Dolby audio, Continue Watching).
